Australia Secure Semi-Final Spot with Victory over Cook Islands

02 Nov 2026, 04:31 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Match Summary

Australia maintained their position at the top of Pool A in the Rugby League World Cup with a decisive 66-6 victory over the Cook Islands in Townsville. While the result confirms their path to the semi-finals, the performance highlighted ongoing areas for improvement for the defending champions.

Key Match Developments

  • Early Dominance: Despite a modest start, Australia established a 28-6 lead by halftime, buoyed by multi-try efforts from key players.
  • Statistical Dominance: Reece Walsh delivered a standout performance, earning player of the match honors while operating as a primary playmaker.
  • Execution Challenges: The Kangaroos struggled with ball control throughout the match, finishing at a 66% completion rate and committing several uncharacteristic errors.
  • Injuries and Discipline: Concerns linger regarding an injury to Reece Walsh, which limited his goal-kicking duties, and general team discipline, which has been cited as a focus area for coach Kevin Walters moving forward.

Future Implications

With the group stage concluded, Australia looks ahead to a semi-final fixture in mid-November. The identity of their opponent remains subject to the outcome of the upcoming match between Tonga and Samoa. Observers have noted that while the team remains the favorite, improvements in intensity and goal-kicking consistency will be necessary to challenge for the title.

How to Verify

  • Official match reports are available through the tournament’s official Rugby League World Cup website.
  • Official team injury bulletins are typically released through the national rugby league governing body press office.
